scientific_integrity: Exact determinant identities and symbolic verifier; no finite-sampling extrapolation. Distinct kernels are counted independently even if quotient targets are isomorphic.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least seven; smooth parameter s^2 != 4. Classifies reduced finite etale schemes of geometrically decomposed Richelot kernels and their Frobenius types; does not assert elliptic-product descent over the ground field. Geometric counts 3,4,6 and Richelot determinant criterion are prior results. Equivalent historical arithmetic treatments remain a priority risk. No independent validation or external audit.
title: Arithmetic splitting of geometrically decomposed Richelot kernels in a cubic-symmetric genus-two pencil
